reasoning: The agent sustains an explicit, continuously-updated done/partial/failing ledger across the whole horizon (every step's Analysis), uses it to pick next actions, catches most of its own omissions, and ultimately names the IRC stuck state and defers it — behavior between anchors 5 and 8. It falls short of a clean 8/10 because the stuck-state recognition came only after repeated circular reverts (budget burned rather than early tactic-switch), completion claims were optimistic, and several contract areas were tracked in prose but never cross-checked or verified, so the map was not reliably precise against the full spec surface.
